prompt: A knight in battered steel plate armor, braced in a low wide stance facing south-east, head thrown back, as a sudden column of blazing white-gold holy radiance slams down into him from above. The light bursts outward at his shoulders and gauntlets, gold cracks of power running along his pauldrons and down his raised sword, his tattered crimson cape snapping backward from the force of the surge. The background is a dim cathedral courtyard at dusk, the only source of light is the divine column pouring into the knight.

A muscular warrior in white and gold tabard over chainmail, caught mid-surge of power, hunched then flexing, both fists clenched and raised, roaring upward. Brilliant white-gold holy light bursts from within his body, radiant cracks of gold splitting along his swelling arms and chest as divine strength swells him larger. Crepuscular rays of white-gold light halo him. The background is a shadowed stone temple interior, the only source of light is the holy glow erupting from the warrior himself.

A knight in polished silver plate armor lunging forward to the south-east in a powerful sprinting stride, sword raised overhead and blazing with white-gold holy fire, a comet-trail of radiant white-gold light streaming off the blade and pouring down his arm into his body. The ground beneath his stride cracks with veins of gold light from the force. His white surcoat and cape billow back. The background is a dim battlefield at dusk under a grey sky, the only source of light is the holy radiance off his sword.
